venue.name: The Alloy Hotel
venue.address: 301 W Dekalb Pike, King of Prussia, PA 19406

items.information: **This competition is on a Thursday night (6-10pm), and 3x3 is NOT being held. Only one guest per competitor is permitted.** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
